dedupe_keys.name: global transmission database of existing and planned interconnection capacity

description: The Global Transmission Database compiles existing and planned cross-border electricity transmission capacities from public sources. Its research collaboration provides country-to-country links and subnational regional links for eleven larger countries, covering land and subsea pathways. The concept record resolves to version 1.1, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15527469, with four capacity CSV tables, a region mapping and a source register. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. Capacity is expressed in megawatts at aggregated connection level; this is not a detailed conductor, substation or protection-system model. Source dates differ, and planned capacity does not establish completed construction or operational availability. A reviewer-assessed use is representing interregional transfer limits and expansion options in energy-system simulations. model-pypsa and model-osemosys are related planning tools, although region mappings and time assumptions require checking before import. No capacity table was downloaded and no network-flow result was reproduced.
